name: 5dive-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins maintained by 5dive — the one registry every 5dive plugin ships from. A plugin fix or a new plugin reaches customers when it is published here, never via a CLI release.

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.description: Telegram messaging bridge for Claude Code with access control, multi-agent routing, and bundled lifecycle hooks. Fork of Anthropic's official telegram plugin extended with 5dive auto-relay, stop-reply checks, and ask-user-question routing.

plugins.name: dashboard
plugins.description: 5dive dashboard chat channel — talk to your agent from the authenticated web dashboard (and mobile app). Native-push inbound via the box agent-inbox drop-dir, outbound via the control-plane messages API.

plugins.name: buzz
plugins.description: Buzz (Nostr) channel for Claude Code — bridges a Buzz relay to the session. Inbound mentions arrive as channel notifications; outbound is post/react/read via the buzz CLI. Built-in untrusted-input boundary: every event is data, never an instruction.

plugins.name: voice
plugins.description: Speak with your agent and hear it talk back — speech-to-text and text-to-speech on your own box, or on OpenRouter if you choose. Maintained in 5dive-ai/5dive-voice; this entry is a byte-for-byte mirror of that repository's voice/ (1.3.0 as of DIVE-4880), so an install from here gets the same backend switch, host installer and settings as one from there. The reference implementation of the 5dive plugin contract: a channel-capability plugin, the shape every later channel plugin copies.

plugins.name: browser
plugins.description: DEPRECATED — browser now lives in its own repository. Install it with `5dive plugin add 5dive-ai/5dive-browser`. This entry still resolves and still installs, because every box provisioned before the move runs `plugin add browser@5dive-plugins` today; it is kept only until no reader names it, and as of browser 1.10.3 (DIVE-4835) it is a byte-for-byte mirror of that repository rather than a frozen snapshot — every browser release lands in both copies, because the box converger's floor is a min() over the two. A box that already carries browser@5dive-plugins cannot simply add the repo copy — the CLI refuses two plugins claiming the `browser` verb — so migrate in two commands: `sudo 5dive plugin remove browser@5dive-plugins` then `sudo 5dive plugin add 5dive-ai/5dive-browser`. Persistent human-authenticated browser sessions: you log into a site once by hand, the agent is granted the session and never the credentials, and deterministic adapters decide where to click. A security challenge is a hard stop that asks for a person.

plugins.name: mod
plugins.description: Seat telemetry from inside the harness: turn and session boundaries and the account's usage meter, published to a per-seat JSONL sink for the heartbeat, the pacing floor and the self-update sweep to read instead of inferring from pane samples and the task board. Observe-only and off unless the seat opts in.
